edition.notes: Not a shastra quote. Short plain katha told in many North Indian homes on Monday vrata. Local tellings vary; this is a compressed seva text, not a critical edition.

description.hi: सोमवार व्रत की सरल कथा — बिल्व, जल, नाम जप।
description.en: A plain Monday-vrata story — bel, water, Name.
